base: complex proper elliptic four-dimensional Sklyanin, order n not1,2,4 or infinite
H3_obstruction: PI3 with dim Z3=dim B1=4 has base-point-free finite surjective norm map P3->P3; every central cubic is a linear times quadratic product. Hence no domain quotient. General CY PI3 H3 requires dim Z3>=5.
scope: Only weighted Hilbert/canonical/rank identities are computed. Full exclusion is an ordinary proof using primary WWY centre inputs and the norm-map lemma; no formal proof or independent referee claimed.
